item.title: Nisus Finance Launches $50M Tokenized Real Estate Offering
item.summary: India-based Nisus Finance Services Co. Ltd. has launched NIFCOT1, its first tokenized investment offering backed by the Nisus High Yield Growth Fund, a Dubai-based real estate fund regulated in the Dubai International Financial Centre. The initiative marks the company’s entry into tokenized real-world assets and is aimed at bringing institutional real estate investment onto blockchain […] The post Nisus Finance Launches $50M Tokenized Real Estate Offering appeared first on CoinTrust .
